propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters materially increase plan-review latency and reduce completion-verification PASS rates, affecting <1% of work tickets but requiring blocking admission control.

Plan review must return a deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false before any LLM call when a ticket description exceeds the configured maximum; light-bug review retains only the P4 description block in det_blocking while downgrading other DET blocks.

Completion verification must return a validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when the authoritative ticket description exceeds the configured maximum, after loading the [verify] setting and before child checks.
The blocking description-size limit is configurable via typed [verify] configuration with a default of 8,000 characters; exactly 8,000 characters is admitted and 8,001 characters is blocked.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory when description is within the maximum, and P4 emits at most one oversize finding.
Tickets must be reduced below the maximum by the operator using existing force-override mechanisms; neither gate truncates, summarizes, or elides content.
